recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the base-element intent of FHIR-29114 without broadening Procedure or pre-judging later structured-parameter proposals.
issue_request: FHIR-29114 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care R5 change request to add supportingInfo to the base Procedure resource as 0..* Reference(Any), with a definition for other patient-record resources relevant to the procedure.
initial_application: The issue was applied by d1143ee, which added Procedure.supportingInfo to the Procedure spreadsheet, and 658b09f, which added supportingInfo to a Procedure example. The 33b409a source rework moved Procedure into StructureDefinition XML and retained the J#29114 element, but also retained the stale sentence saying this extension should not be used.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists procedure=Procedure, so the Procedure StructureDefinition is in build scope. Jira comments clarify the workflow-supportingInfo extension did not apply to Procedure. The 2020-10-08 Patient Care minutes reference FHIR-29114, and direct Zulip search found no conflicting discussion. Later Procedure parameter issues FHIR-33391 and FHIR-46303 ask for richer structured details and do not supersede this wording fix.
reconciliation: Changed the Procedure.supportingInfo definition from 'This extension' to 'This element' in source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml and made the same one-word correction in source/procedure/procedure.svg, preserving the approved cardinality, target, and meaning.
source_changes: source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml: changed Procedure.supportingInfo definition wording from 'This extension' to 'This element'.
source/procedure/procedure.svg: changed the matching Procedure.supportingInfo tooltip wording from 'This extension' to 'This element'.

related_jiras.note: Later Resolved - No Change request for ServiceRequest-like structured Procedure parameters; it does not alter the base supportingInfo wording.
Later duplicate of FHIR-33391 that mentions supportingInfo but seeks a distinct parameter structure.
Unrelated Procedure.report search-parameter work was bundled in the same historical source commit as the FHIR-29114 spreadsheet change.
